rounds.text: Impex Ferro Tech Ltd is currently exhibiting powerful market momentum, evidenced by a Relative Strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 and a 12-month price return of 89.3% [E35, E36]. The stock is trading at the very top of its 52-week range, supported by a technical setup where the price remains above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E33, E34]. From a valuation perspective, the company trades at a significant discount to its peers, with a P/B ratio of 0.25x compared to the sector benchmark of 2.21x [E6]. Furthermore, the firm is benefiting from a favorable macro environment, as the Metals & Mining sector is currently identified as a tailwind [E53, E55]. While the company has achieved a 23% compounded profit growth over the last three years, it is also maintaining an ROCE of 11.9%, which outperforms the sector median of 9.9% [E9, E14, E58]. Conceded: the company faces significant headwinds including a 100% compounded sales growth decline, an EV/EBITDA ratio of 762.66x, and the fact that 100% of promoter holdings are pledged [E10, E11, E45].
